title: Logarithmic approximation of the absolute Rademacher sum
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $a_1,\dots,a_n\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2=1$ and $|a_i|\le\varepsilon$ for every $i$, where $0<\varepsilon\le e^{-1}$. For independent uniform signs $X_1,\dots,X_n\in\{-1,1\}$,
\[
\left|\mathbb E\left|\sum_{i=1}^n a_iX_i\right|-\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\right|\le 4(K+1)\varepsilon\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)},
\]
where $K$ is the third-moment Berry–Esseen constant.
